items.problem: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md Storage section does not mention ApplicationData.ClearAsync() or SetVersionAsync() as APIs that work unchanged in packaged WinUI 3 apps
items.evidence: Dev agent used these APIs directly and they worked, but the skill's Storage section (MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md line 408-416) only covers LocalSettings and LocalFolder, not ClearAsync/SetVersionAsync/SetVersionDeferral/SetVersionRequest
items.why_missed: under-emphasized — the table lists only LocalSettings and LocalFolder but omits other ApplicationData members that also work unchanged
items.proposed_improvement: Add a note to the Storage section stating that all Windows.Storage.ApplicationData members (ClearAsync, SetVersionAsync, Version, LocalCacheFolder, TemporaryFolder, etc.) work unchanged in packaged WinUI 3 desktop apps — the entire ApplicationData API surface is available when the app has package identity
items.generalizes: Many UWP samples use ApplicationData members beyond LocalSettings/LocalFolder. Clarifying that the full API surface works with package identity prevents dev agents from unnecessarily searching for replacements.
